subtitle: Cross-reading of 11 September 2026, confirmed reading of 11/Sep, 1:41 PM BRT (4:41 PM UTC), with the presidential book at USD 148.03M. All five watched contracts received a new price: winner, second place in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), third place, impeachment at the Supreme Court and Senate majority. The national poll entering today is AtlasIntel together with Bloomberg, fieldwork from 04 to 09/Sep, 5,000 interviews and a 1.0pp margin, TSE registration BR-01452/2026. The official TSE registry was ingested today with 879 presidential polls, and the calendar points to six national polls scheduled for release between 14 and 16/Sep.

candidates.name: Lula
candidates.header: PRICE: 42.50% (vol USD 10.69M accumulated) in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 11/Sep, 1:41 PM BRT, down 1.00pp against the price confirmed on 10/Sep, in a second straight day of decline. In the second-place contract for the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) he FELL 1.60pp and stands at 22.90% (vol USD 601 thousand). POLL: 43.0% in the first round and 46.2% in the [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) against Flávio Bolsonaro in the AtlasIntel/Bloomberg of 10/Sep, fieldwork from 04 to 09/Sep, 5,000 interviews and a 1.0pp margin. It is the eighth consecutive national poll since 06/Sep in which he does not come out ahead in the pairing, and the two tenths of difference fit inside two margins, meaning the house measures a statistical tie.
fortes: He remains ahead in the first round in the national poll entering today, 43.0% against 37.4%, and AtlasIntel is the house with the largest sample and the smallest margin in the window, 5,000 interviews and 1.0 point.

Across the five runoff pairings in the round he loses none outside the margin: he trails Flávio Bolsonaro by two tenths, trails Romeu Zema by two tenths, ties Ronaldo Caiado, and wins the only two pairings that fall outside the margin, against Augusto Cury and against Renan Santos.
The winner contract gave back 1.00pp, one tenth of yesterday's 9.00pp fall, meaning the book's move slowed sharply against yesterday.
fracos: Eighth consecutive national poll since 06/Sep in which he does not come out ahead in the pairing against Flávio Bolsonaro.
The winner contract falls for the second day and the distance to the leader went from 9.35pp to 11.45pp.
He sits 25.00pp below his own peak in the winner contract, of 67.50% on 16/Aug.
In the second-place contract for the first round he gave back 1.60pp of the 4.90pp he had gained yesterday.
candidates.analise: 11 September repeats the direction of the previous day at one tenth of the intensity. The winner contract gave back 1.00pp and stands at 42.50% (vol USD 10.69M), against a 9.00pp fall the day before, and the distance to the leader went from 9.35pp to 11.45pp. On the polling side, the round entering today is the AtlasIntel/Bloomberg of 10/Sep, and what it allows is the cleanest comparison of the week, because the house measured the same electorate on 31/Aug with the same method and the same margin. In that comparison he goes from 43.4% to 43.0% in the first round, practically flat, while his rival rises 3.7 points. The lead that was 9.7 points became 5.6. Across the five runoff pairings the picture is one of ties: he trails Flávio Bolsonaro by two tenths, trails Romeu Zema by two tenths, ties Ronaldo Caiado at 45.7%, and wins the two pairings that fall outside the margin. What remains is that the market and the poll describe the same direction and diverge on size: the book already marks 11.45pp of distance, while the house with the smallest margin in the window measures a statistical tie in the head-to-head pairing.

candidates.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
candidates.header: PRICE: 53.95% (vol USD 10.36M accumulated) in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 11/Sep, 1:41 PM BRT, up 1.10pp against the price confirmed on 10/Sep, and 1.15pp below the peak of his series, of 55.10% on 10/Sep. In the second-place contract for the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) he ROSE 3.00pp and stands at 74.50% (vol USD 725 thousand). POLL: 37.4% in the first round and 46.4% in the [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) in the AtlasIntel/Bloomberg of 10/Sep. At the same house, on 31/Aug, he had 33.7% and lost the pairing by 42.6% to 47.1%, so in eleven days he rose 3.7 points in the first round and the pairing travelled 4.7 points.
fortes: A second straight day of gains in the winner contract, 53.95%, above yesterday's 52.85%, and 1.15pp below the peak of the series, of 55.10% on 10/Sep.
In the second-place contract for the first round he rose 3.00pp and stands at 74.50%, undoing the opposite move of the previous day, when that contract had moved in his rival's favour.

In the AtlasIntel, which is the same house as on 31/Aug, he rose 3.7 points in the first round and the runoff pairing travelled 4.7 points in his favour over eleven days, with no change of method and no change of margin.
fracos: His lead in the AtlasIntel runoff pairing is two tenths and fits inside two margins of 1.0, so it is a statistical tie and not a lead.
In the first round he still trails by 5.6 points, a distance that falls outside the margin.
The dispersion between houses in the first round is the widest on the panel, from 29% at Quaest to 40% at Palver in the window since 06/Sep, eleven points.
The price reading in this round is LATER than this morning's disclosure that he has been under investigation since July in the Dark Horse case for money laundering, currency evasion and corruption.
candidates.analise: A second straight day of gains in the winner contract, now 1.10pp, and the 53.95% sits 1.15pp below the peak of his series, of 55.10% on 10/Sep. The volume accumulated in his contract is USD 10.36M. In the second-place contract for the first round the move is the inverse of yesterday's: up 3.00pp, to 74.50%, after falling 7.00pp the day before. The two contracts together describe a market that has gone back to seeing it as more likely that he finishes the first round in second place and still wins the election. In the poll, the AtlasIntel repeats the direction: 33.7% to 37.4% in the first round and a runoff pairing that travelled 4.7 points in eleven days, moving from a defeat by 42.6% to 47.1% into a two tenths advantage. ⚠️ Two tenths fit inside the margin, so what the house measures is a tie, not a lead. 📌 And the provenance of the reading matters today: the prices on this page are from 1:41 PM BRT, therefore LATER than the disclosure, on the morning of 11/Sep, that he has been under investigation since July in the inquiry into the financing of the film Dark Horse. AFOS records the order of events and does not attribute cause to the price.

candidates.name: Augusto Cury
candidates.header: PRICE: 0.45% in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 11/Sep, 1:41 PM BRT, and 52.90% in the third-place contract for the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) (vol USD 160 thousand), where he is the favourite, up 3.65pp. POLL: 6.6% in the first round in the AtlasIntel/Bloomberg of 10/Sep, against 7.8% at the same house on 31/Aug, and 41.1% against Lula's 43.8% in a [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) pairing, one of the two pairings in the round that fall outside the margin.
fortes: In the third-place contract for the first round he rose 3.65pp and reached 52.90%, and the distance to the runner-up there more than doubled, from 6.75pp to 14.40pp.
He is one of the two names whose runoff pairing against Lula falls OUTSIDE the margin in this round, which makes his reading less ambiguous than that of the statistical ties.
In the window since 06/Sep he reaches 12.2% at Veritá, the highest value of any third name in the period.
fracos: In the winner contract he remains at 0.45%, below half a point.
He fell from 7.8% to 6.6% in the first round at the same house, over eleven days.
His range in the window runs from 4% to 12.2%, eight points of dispersion between houses over the same period.
candidates.analise: His move is in the third-place contract for the first round, where he rose 3.65pp and reached 52.90% (vol USD 160 thousand), while the runner-up there fell 4.00pp. The gap between the two more than doubled in 24 hours, from 6.75pp to 14.40pp. In the winner contract he remains at 0.45%, and that distance between the two contracts is itself the description of what the market is saying: he is the favourite to finish third and is barely considered to win. In the poll, the AtlasIntel measures him at 6.6%, against 7.8% at the same house eleven days earlier, and in a runoff pairing against Lula he trails by 43.8% to 41.1%, one of the two distances in the round that fall outside the margin.

candidates.name: Renan Santos
candidates.header: PRICE: 1.95% (vol USD 13.26M accumulated) in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 11/Sep, 1:41 PM BRT, down 0.20pp, and 38.50% in the third-place contract for the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) (vol USD 297 thousand), down 4.00pp, the largest of any contract on the panel this round. POLL: 6.5% in the first round in the AtlasIntel/Bloomberg of 10/Sep, against 7.6% at the same house on 31/Aug, and 33.8% against Lula's 46.0% in the [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) pairing, a distance of 12.2 points that narrowed by 9.3 points in eleven days.
fortes: His contract still holds USD 13.26M accumulated, the second largest individual volume in the presidential book.
In the runoff pairing against Lula he narrowed the gap by 9.3 points in eleven days within the SAME house, from 47.5% to 26.0% into 46.0% to 33.8%.
The Palver of 09/Sep still measures him at 11% in the first round, the top of his range in the window.
fracos: The largest fall of any contract on the panel this round, 4.00pp in the third-place contract for the first round.
He fell from 7.6% to 6.5% in the first round at the same house, over eleven days.
The runoff pairing against Lula still carries 12.2 points of distance, the widest of the five tested.
candidates.analise: The largest fall of any contract on the panel this round is his: 4.00pp in the third-place contract for the first round, from 42.50% to 38.50%. In the winner contract he fell 0.20pp and stands at 1.95%, with USD 13.26M accumulated, the second largest individual volume in the book. In the poll the signal is more favourable than the price. Within the same house, over eleven days, the runoff pairing against Lula narrowed by 9.3 points, from 47.5% to 26.0% into 46.0% to 33.8%. In the first round he gave back from 7.6% to 6.5%. Dispersion between houses remains his defining trait: the Palver of 09/Sep measures him at 11% and the PoderData of 10/Sep at 3%, eight points of difference over overlapping fieldwork.

candidates.name: Caiado / Haddad / Zema
candidates.header: PRICE: Ronaldo Caiado at 0.30% in the winner contract and 5.00% in the third-place contract for the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), the only watched contract that does not move in this round; Romeu Zema at 0.15% (vol USD 6.92M) and Fernando Haddad at 0.05% (vol USD 7.53M), both at the floor of the book, confirmed reading of 11/Sep, 1:41 PM BRT. POLL: in the AtlasIntel/Bloomberg of 10/Sep, Caiado has 1.1% and Zema 2.1% in the first round. In the [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) pairings against Lula, Caiado TIES EXACTLY at 45.7% and Zema comes out ahead by 46.2% to 46.0%, both inside the margin.
candidates.subtitle: Back of the field in the reading of 10/Sep, 2:20 PM BRT (17:20 UTC). ⚠️ THE PODERDATA/AYA OF 10/Sep MEASURES CAIADO AT 2% AND TESTS NEITHER ZEMA NOR HADDAD in the prompted scenario. All three remain below the 0.5% floor of the double reading in the winner contract, so the prices in this band enter as a simple reading.

caiado.label: CAIADO (PSD), 0.25% (vol USD 7.37M) in the WINNER contract, reading of 10/Sep, 2:20 PM BRT, and below the 0.5% floor of the double reading. In the THIRD-PLACE contract for the first round he stands at 5.00%, on a USD 120 thousand book. In the PoderData/Aya of 10/Sep he has 2% in the first round.
caiado.fortes: ⭐ IN BOTH HOUSES OF THE WEEK HE HAS THE TIGHTEST [RUNOFF](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) PAIRING AFTER THE ONE INVOLVING THE RUNNER-UP: 46% to 43% at BTG/Nexus of 08/Sep, the smallest margin among the three pairings in which that house hands the leader the win, and 41% to 38% at Quaest of 07/Sep. And he rose 0.50pp in the first-round third-place contract, back to 10.00%.
caiado.fracos: ⚠️ In the WINNER contract he remains below the 0.5% floor, and it is the only one of the three universes in which he does not move. In the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) the two houses measure him at 4% and 3%, with no meaningful change against their previous rounds.

haddad.label: HADDAD (PT), 0.05% (vol USD 7.43M) in the WINNER contract, reading of 10/Sep, 2:20 PM BRT, and at the floor of the book. He is not a presidential candidate: he is running for governor of São Paulo, and the PoderData/Aya of 10/Sep does not test him in a presidential scenario.
haddad.fortes: He is not tested as a presidential candidate in the national polls of the window, and neither BTG/Nexus of 08/Sep nor Quaest of 07/Sep tests him, so there is no ballot-box reading to cross against the price.
haddad.fracos: The contract remains open under his name by inheritance of the market's design, not by a declared candidacy, and the panel keeps the line only so the residual price is not read as a signal.

zema.label: ZEMA (Novo), 0.15% (vol USD 6.85M) in the WINNER contract, reading of 10/Sep, 2:20 PM BRT, below the 0.5% floor of the double reading. In the THIRD-PLACE contract for the first round he stands at 0.75%, on a USD 50 thousand book. The PoderData/Aya of 10/Sep does not test him in the prompted scenario.
zema.fortes: BTG/Nexus of 08/Sep measures him at 2% in the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) scenario that includes Pablo Marçal, against 1% in the scenario without him, and Quaest of 07/Sep measures him at 2%. The three readings fit inside each house's margin of 2 points.
zema.fracos: ⚠️ IN THE [RUNOFF](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) PAIRINGS HE IS THE MOST COMFORTABLE FOR THE LEADER IN BOTH HOUSES: 47% to 40% at BTG/Nexus and 44% to 33% at Quaest, that is 7 and 11 points of distance. And he stayed put at 0.85% in the first-round third-place contract, behind Pablo Marçal, who stands at 1.75%.

candidates.analise: The block of low-priced names carries the least intuitive finding of the polling round. In the AtlasIntel, Ronaldo Caiado TIES EXACTLY with Lula at 45.7% in a runoff pairing, and Romeu Zema comes out ahead by 46.2% to 46.0%, both inside the margin. On 31/Aug the same house had Caiado behind by 41.0% to 46.6% and Zema behind by 40.7% to 47.0%. In the first round, however, Caiado has 1.1% and Zema 2.1%, and in the winner contracts they stand at 0.30% and 0.15%. 📌 The contrast is the measurement, not the interpretation: the same names the house measures as tied in a head-to-head second-stage pairing are barely considered by the market to get there. Fernando Haddad, at 0.05% and with USD 7.53M accumulated, is not tested in a presidential scenario by the house.
fortes: Ronaldo Caiado TIES EXACTLY with Lula at 45.7% in a runoff pairing of the AtlasIntel, and on 31/Aug the same house had him behind by 41.0% to 46.6%.
Romeu Zema comes out AHEAD of Lula by 46.2% to 46.0% in the runoff pairing, and records 2.1% in the first round, his highest value in the window.
Caiado's third-place contract for the first round, at 5.00%, is the only watched contract that does not move in this round.
fracos: None of the three exceeds 2.1% in the first round of the AtlasIntel, and the runoff statistical ties sit alongside first-round values of one to two points.
In the winner contracts, Caiado stands at 0.30%, Zema at 0.15% and Haddad at 0.05%.
Fernando Haddad is not tested in a presidential scenario by the house.

cruzamento: 📈 THE GAP IN THE WINNER CONTRACT WIDENED FOR THE SECOND DAY: Flávio Bolsonaro stands at 53.95% (vol USD 10.36M) and Lula at 42.50% (vol USD 10.69M), against 52.85% and 43.50% in the confirmed reading of 10/Sep. That is 1.10pp up for one and 1.00pp down for the other, and the distance went from 9.35pp to 11.45pp. ⚠️ THE SIZE OF THE MOVE IS ONE TENTH OF YESTERDAY'S, when the book travelled 6.60pp and 9.00pp and changed hands at the top. Today it keeps the same direction, slowly. ⭐ THE POLL ENTERING TODAY ALLOWS THE CLEANEST COMPARISON OF THE WEEK, because it comes from the SAME HOUSE that measured eleven days earlier, with the same method and the same margin. In the AtlasIntel/Bloomberg, Lula's lead in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) fell from 9.7 points to 5.6: he went from 43.4% to 43.0% and Flávio Bolsonaro went from 33.7% to 37.4%. 🔁 AND ALL FIVE [RUNOFF](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) PAIRINGS MOVED IN THE SAME DIRECTION, two of them flipping sign: against Flávio, from 47.1% to 42.6% into 46.4% to 46.2%; against Romeu Zema, from 47.0% to 40.7% into 46.2% to 46.0%; against Ronaldo Caiado, from 46.6% to 41.0% into an exact tie at 45.7%; against Renan Santos, from 47.5% to 26.0% into 46.0% to 33.8%. The first three fit inside two margins of 1.0, so they are statistical ties. 📌 WHERE THE TWO INSTRUMENTS DIVERGE IS IN SIZE, NOT DIRECTION. The book marks 11.45pp of distance between the top two, while the house with the smallest margin in the window measures two tenths in the head-to-head pairing. 🥉 IN THE THIRD-PLACE CONTRACT the distance more than doubled: Augusto Cury rose 3.65pp, to 52.90%, and Renan Santos fell 4.00pp, to 38.50%, with the gap going from 6.75pp to 14.40pp. 🏛️ THE CONTRACT ON A SUPREME COURT JUSTICE LEAVING BY IMPEACHMENT BEFORE 2027 ALMOST DOUBLED, from 4.35% to 8.30% (vol USD 90 thousand), up 3.95pp, the day after secrecy was lifted in the Master case. It remains 17.80pp below the peak of the series, of 26.10% recorded on 11/Sep itself at 5:00 AM BRT, and the volume of USD 90 thousand is small enough that isolated orders can move the price. 🗳️ The Senate majority contract gets a new price, with Partido Liberal at 83.00% (vol USD 261 thousand). ⏳ The TSE calendar, ingested today with 879 presidential polls in the file, points to six national polls scheduled for release between 14 and 16/Sep: Quaest and Nexus on 14/Sep, MDA and Indexa on 15/Sep, Datatrends and American Analytics on 16/Sep. Datafolha and Veritá closed fieldwork today.
